Quantify a scalar chromatography batch with external calibration

Source: R/batch-quantitation.R
measure_quantify_batch.Rd

measure_quantify_batch() runs a complete single-analyte, external calibration workflow over a scalar measure_record(): peak detection and integration via step_measure_peaks_detect() and step_measure_peaks_integrate(), calibration fitting via measure_calibration_fit(), QC verification via measure_calibration_verify(), dilution back-calculation, and explicit per-injection outcome flagging.

Usage

measure_quantify_batch(
  record,
  manifest,
  window,
  channel_id = NULL,
  analyte = "analyte",
  conc_unit = NULL,
  calibration_revision = "cal-v1",
  peak_algorithm = "prominence",
  min_height = 0,
  min_prominence = 0,
  min_distance = 0,
  algorithm_params = list(),
  integration_method = c("trapezoid", "simpson"),
  baseline = c("local", "none", "global"),
  model = c("linear", "quadratic"),
  weights = c("none", "1/x", "1/x2", "1/y", "1/y2"),
  origin = FALSE,
  lloq = NULL,
  uloq = NULL,
  qc_acceptance_pct = 15,
  blank_max_area = NULL,
  blank_max_pct_lloq = 20
)

# S3 method for class 'measure_batch_results'
print(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'measure_batch_results'
summary(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'measure_batch_results'
tidy(x, ...)

Arguments

record

A measure_record() containing one scalar chromatogram per injection on the target channel.

manifest

A data frame describing the batch injections with required columns:

  • injection_id: Unique character IDs matching record$injections.

  • injection_type: One of "standard", "blank", "qc", or "unknown".

  • nominal_conc: Numeric nominal concentration (finite for "standard" and "qc", NA or 0 for "blank", NA for "unknown"). Optional columns:

  • dilution_factor: Positive finite numeric dilution factor (default 1). Applied to back-calculate original sample concentration after checking in-vial concentration against [lloq, uloq].

  • batch_order: Integer run order (default seq_len(nrow(manifest))).

window

Length-2 finite numeric vector c(min, max) defining the target analyte retention-time window (window[1] < window[2]).

channel_id

Optional channel ID when record has multiple channels. Required if record$channels has more than one row.

analyte

Single non-empty string naming the target analyte.

conc_unit

Optional single non-empty string declaring concentration units (e.g., "mg/L").

calibration_revision

Single non-empty string identifying the calibration revision recorded on each quantified injection.

peak_algorithm

Peak detection algorithm passed to step_measure_peaks_detect(). Default "prominence".

min_height

Minimum peak height passed to step_measure_peaks_detect().

min_prominence

Minimum peak prominence passed to step_measure_peaks_detect().

min_distance

Minimum peak distance passed to step_measure_peaks_detect().

algorithm_params

Optional list of algorithm-specific parameters passed to step_measure_peaks_detect().

integration_method

Integration rule passed to step_measure_peaks_integrate(): "trapezoid" (default) or "simpson".

baseline

Peak baseline convention passed to step_measure_peaks_integrate(): "local" (default), "none", or "global".

model

Calibration model passed to measure_calibration_fit(): "linear" (default) or "quadratic".

weights

Calibration weighting scheme passed to measure_calibration_fit().

origin

Logical; force calibration curve through the origin? Default FALSE.

lloq

Optional lower limit of quantitation (in-vial concentration). Defaults to the minimum positive fitted standard concentration.

uloq

Optional upper limit of quantitation (in-vial concentration). Defaults to the maximum fitted standard concentration.

qc_acceptance_pct

Maximum allowed absolute percent deviation from nominal for standards and QC samples. Default 15.

blank_max_area

Optional absolute peak area ceiling for blank injections. When NULL (default), blanks are checked against blank_max_pct_lloq percent of the fitted response at lloq.

blank_max_pct_lloq

Percent of LLOQ response tolerated in a blank when blank_max_area is NULL. Default 20.

x

A measure_batch_results object.

...

Additional arguments (unused).

object

A measure_batch_results object.

Value

A measure_batch_results object (inheriting from measure_results()) with components:

  • results: Per-injection tibble linking provenance, peaks, areas, calibration revision, estimated/reported concentrations, and outcomes.

  • calibration: Fitted measure_calibration object.

  • verification: measure_calibration_verify object for QC injections (or NULL if no QC injections are present).

  • method: Named list of declared batch parameters and source digests.

  • peaks: All detected peaks across injections for diagnostics.

  • data, measures, id_cols: Inherited measure_results() fields for plotting and report rendering.

Details

Every reported row links back to its sample_id, injection_id, curve_id, source_id, source_sha256, parsed source-row bounds, selected peak bounds, area, calibration_revision, estimated and reported concentrations, and QC status. Missing peaks, multiple coeluting/interfering peaks in the analyte window, blank interferences, and out-of-range unknowns ("below_lloq" / "above_uloq") are reported as distinct outcomes rather than silently coerced to zero or extrapolated as valid.

See also

measure_record_curves(), measure_calibration_fit(), measure_calibration_verify(), measure_results(), render_measure_report()

Examples

path <- system.file(
  "extdata",
  "lc_batch_control.csv",
  package = "measure",
  mustWork = TRUE
)
manifest_path <- system.file(
  "extdata",
  "lc_batch_manifest.csv",
  package = "measure",
  mustWork = TRUE
)
cols <- c(
  sample_id = "sample_id",
  injection_id = "injection_id",
  channel_id = "channel_id",
  channel_name = "channel_name",
  curve_id = "curve_id",
  axis_name = "axis_name",
  axis_unit = "axis_unit",
  value_name = "value_name",
  value_unit = "value_unit",
  location = "location",
  value = "value"
)
rec <- read_measure_record_delim(path, cols, source_id = "lc-batch-control")
manifest <- utils::read.csv(manifest_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
batch <- measure_quantify_batch(
  rec,
  manifest,
  window = c(4.8, 5.6),
  analyte = "caffeine_control",
  conc_unit = "mg/L",
  calibration_revision = "cal-control-v1",
  min_prominence = 1.0
)
summary(batch)
